formulas.total_market_cap: validated same-day legacy value first; otherwise raw close * same-day total shares
formulas.notlimited_marketcap_a: raw close * validated same-day A float shares
formulas.pe_ttm: market cap / TTM parent net profit; positive inputs only
formulas.pb_mrq: raw close / same-report-period BPS; positive inputs only
formulas.ttm_parent_profit: annual: current full year; other quarters: current YTD + prior full year - prior same-quarter YTD

share_mapping.total_shares: cn_stock_shares.total_shares; validated cn_stock_capital event only for missing daily values

descriptor_inheritance: earliest available latest Eastmoney record; explicit later_record_backfill; conflicting org_code left NULL
revisions: same-definition metric supplement merges into full new version; unchanged metrics keep original provenance
missing: NULL with reasons; no interpolation or stale-price substitution; source zero change_ratio retained
